summary: Derived from the attributed TEN ten-point certificate (Rishi Khan) via our previous record beiyi-ten-raise-c; all notices retained, changes documented under Apache-2.0 §4(b). A re-implemented exact checker gives every leaf's exact floor; the 10 leaves with the lowest floor were each replaced in place by one new leaf (new term kinds, anchors, λ and multiplier rows chosen by a linear program over the leaf cell, then checked exactly), with the zfE payload re-encoded by the same range coder (all other leaves bit-identical). The certified floor c rises to 78636833157335904747230439001/2^23·10^24, the floor of the 11th tightest leaf, so κ = (H_W⁻ − B)/(1 − c) improves by about 1.62e-9. Weights, B, H_W⁻, tangent table and pyramids are unchanged. Kernel-level build (skipKernelTC removed) passed; axioms only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.
method: Exact re-certification of the 10 tightest leaves of the attributed TEN ten-point certificate, raising its floor c
